description: Builds OCAPI URIs locally and sends them to remote OOB controllers to get information back.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category to execute on OOB controller.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: Command to execute on OOB controller.

parameters.name: job_name
parameters.description: Name of job for fetching status.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password for authenticating to OOB controller.

parameters.name: proxy_slot_number
parameters.description: For proxied inband requests, the slot number of the IOM. Only applies if baseuri is a proxy server.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds for URL requests to OOB controller. Default: 10

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username for authenticating to OOB controller.

examples:
- name: Get job status
  community.general.ocapi_info:
    category: Status
    command: JobStatus
    baseuri: "http://iom1.wdc.com"
    jobName: FirmwareUpdate
    username: "{{ username }}"
    password: "{{ password }}"

return_values.name: details
return_values.description: Details of the relevant operation. Applies to command=JobStatus. Returned: when supported

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Message with action result or error description. Returned: always Sample: "Action was successful"

return_values.name: operationHealth
return_values.description: Health of the operation. Applies to command=JobStatus. See OCAPI documentation for details. Returned: when supported Sample: "OK"

return_values.name: operationHealthId
return_values.description: Integer value for health of the operation (corresponds to operationHealth). Applies to command=JobStatus. See OCAPI documentation for details. Returned: when supported Sample: "OK"

return_values.name: operationStatus
return_values.description: Status of the relevant operation. Applies to command=JobStatus. See OCAPI documentation for details. Returned: when supported Sample: "Activate needed"

return_values.name: operationStatusId
return_values.description: Integer value of status (corresponds to operationStatus). Applies to command=JobStatus. See OCAPI documentation for details. Returned: when supported Sample: 65540

return_values.name: percentComplete
return_values.description: Percent complete of the relevant operation. Applies to command=JobStatus. Returned: when supported Sample: 99

return_values.name: status
return_values.description: Dictionary containing status information. See OCAPI documentation for details. Returned: when supported Sample: {"Details": ["None"], "Health": [{"ID": 5, "Name": "OK"}], "State": {"ID": 16, "Name": "In service"}}
